name: HStack
description: HStack is a horizontal layout primitive built on Flex. It arranges items in a row with configurable justification, alignment, and spacing, making it an easy drop-in for horizontal stacks of elements.

props.name: as
props.description: Polymorphic prop to change the rendered element type

props.name: justify
props.description: Distribution of items along the main axis, supports responsive values

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of items along the cross axis, supports responsive values

props.name: gap
props.description: Shorthand spacing between items, supports responsive values
